details:
I noticed my right WMR controller sometimes suddenly disabled and it showed one-controller movement with only forward/backward/left turn/right turn. This is sort of Position control.
I need shake with joystick and trigger to recover it. But even it's recovered, chance is big it's disabled again in short or long time.
This problem seems happens to many WMR users. Especially if you use WMR mainly for gestures / signing, you will go suddenly forward or rotate while touching touchpad....
I try track down when problems started in old video recordings. But i know this never happened in past times, and now the problem exist for some months already.

I know now VRChat seems disable the controllers sometimes for no reason, and they suddenly enabled after joystick/trigger touching. Why? I have no idea. I need find out why my right controller is disabled many times.

My friend uses also WMR, this time it seems his left controller is disabled sometimes. I can see he suddenly moves forward. Same problem as me, for me with right controller.

I am afraid VRChat has more bugs for WMR users. I know already the main trigger is not more analog (means smooth 0-100% motion in pressing trigger) but just direct on/off. Before it was perfect analog control.
Also the WMR control in SDK2 car control is broken. So they are examples why WMR support in VRChat is lately not more good and kinda buggy.

With new headset HP Reverb2, also WMR headset... i should analyse why there are some WMR bugs lately. Is VRChat itself bad or is SteamVR lately many changed for VRChat?
